texts.bbe: Grace be with all those who have true love for our Lord Jesus Christ.
texts.message: Pure grace and nothing but grace be with all who love our Master, Jesus Christ.
texts.nkjv: Grace [be] with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen.
texts.net: Grace be* with all of those who love our Lord Jesus Christ with an undying love.*
